reviews.body:
Thanks, this is the last OpenAI-compatible backend that dropped the stored limit. Using `maxTokensOrDefault` keeps gpt2giga on the same default as #1870, and adding it to the existing `maxtokens_test.go` table is the right place for the test.

I read the full diff. The 2048 default for providers saved by `auth add` is called out in the description, and build, tests and `validate` are green at `04b5f0b`. Good to merge.
